name: Lynda Talgo
quote: Jasmine is an exceptional guide for anyone looking to deepen their self-awareness and mental resilience. During our 7 weeks of PQ training together, I was consistently impressed by her warmth, openness, and ability to hold space for meaningful change. Her approach helped me address the goals I had for my relationships, leading to a greater sense of calm and happiness. If you are seeking a coach who is as insightful as she is empathetic, Jasmine is the perfect choice.
